open_risks_and_limitations.name: PROXIMITY_WINDOW_NOT_EVENT_RATE_JUSTIFIED
open_risks_and_limitations.note: The 18h PROXIMITY_HOURS campaign-association window (live_wire.py:104) was NEVER justified against Farouk's observed inter-campaign spacing - K-052 failure class. F006->F007 arrived 17.6h apart (INSIDE the window), already breaching the hard constraint. RATIFIED (D-057) as a demo-lane prerequisite ALONGSIDE the terminal-marker canonical shape: the marker reduces the nominal-open SET, the re-justification addresses the WIDTH - neither alone sufficient. RE-JUSTIFICATION CONSTRAINT: a proximity window must be NARROWER than the source's MINIMUM observed inter-campaign interval or ambiguity is guaranteed by construction; derive from the FULL observed spacing distribution across all campaigns, not the single closest pair (17.6h is an upper bound already breached, not the target). RE-DERIVED 2026-07-21 (D-064) from the FULL observed spacing distribution (7 campaigns): min inter-campaign interval = 2.2h (F003->F004; also 4.8h F001->F002); max management-tail (last instruction - entry) = 3.9h (F001). DECISIVE FINDING: management-tail (3.9h) EXCEEDS the min inter-campaign interval (2.2h), so a single time-proximity window CANNOT both catch all legitimate same-session management (needs >=3.9h) AND avoid two-campaign overlap (needs <2.2h) - window-narrowing ALONE is mathematically insufficient, proven from data. THEREFORE the TERMINAL-MARKER (D-063, built+proven) is the NECESSARY structural fix: it removes CLOSED campaigns from the open set so the window only ever disambiguates genuinely-CONCURRENT opens. RECOMMENDED post-marker window = ~6h (covers the 3.9h max tail + headroom; management is same-session per the drift-canary justification), with P02 fail-closed pause as the safe backstop for residual concurrency (never mis-assigns). 18h CONFIRMED UNFIT AND SUPERSEDED. ~6h RATIFIED IN PRINCIPLE (D-065), value frozen with derivation cited (3.9h observed max tail + headroom). SEQUENCE: deploy the 18->~6 change AFTER the terminal-marker is live (the marker changes the population the window operates on) - NOT bundled with it, its own before/after + no-op proof. K-052 REVIEW TRIGGER registered: re-derive once campaign count materially exceeds 7, since both the 2.2h min interval and 3.9h max tail are single-observation extremes at n=7. Impossibility proof = K-055.

open_risks_and_limitations.name: LANE_A_ENTRY_MODEL_ADVERSE_DIVERGENCE
open_risks_and_limitations.escalated: 2026-07-21 MECHANISM PROVEN (operator source screenshot ~09:54Z + independent bar verification): F007 instruction 'sl entry on lowest entry' RESOLVED DIFFERENTLY in each model - Lane A's only filled leg was near@4063 so its BE went to 4063; his lowest actual fill was 4059.71 so his BE sits there (screenshot: BUY 1 +943 USD open, SL line 4059.71, price 4069.15). BARS: first touch <=4063 at 09:29Z (low 4062.54, Lane A P10 scratch fired); post-instruction window LOW 4061.07 at 09:42Z - NEVER reached 4059.71 (1.36pt clearance); price 4068.68 by 09:55Z with his runner still open. SAME INSTRUCTION, DIFFERENT RESOLVED STOP, MATERIALLY DIFFERENT OUTCOME: the three-leg EDGE-PLACEMENT model produced a PREMATURE TERMINAL and forfeited a runner the source still holds in profit. THE single most consequential structural finding in the project: a disciplined follower on Lane A's entry model may SYSTEMATICALLY lose runners the source keeps. Direct evidence for the Lane B entry-policy candidate (entries placed where he actually fills - mid-zone - would have resolved 'lowest entry' to 4059.71-class levels and survived).
open_risks_and_limitations.note: WATCH, DO NOT CONCLUDE (operator, n=2): Lane A's modelled entry has been WORSE than Farouk's actual fills for two consecutive campaigns. F006: his 4 fills 4013.02/4009.64/4007.68/4005.72 (avg ~4009.0) vs Lane A 3-leg avg 4007.50 at fill-time - but fills sat OUTSIDE modelled legs (4013.02 above zone top). F007: his 2 fills 4060.55/4059.71 (avg ~4060.13) vs Lane A near-leg-only 4063.00 on a LONG = ~2.9 points ADVERSE. If the three-leg model systematically enters worse than he does, follower expectancy sits systematically below his published results - directly material to the project's core question. STANDING MEASUREMENT: from F008 onward record per campaign (his fills where published, fill count, Lane A filled legs, avg-entry delta signed adverse/favorable). Extends K-018; NO model change without governance. DATA DEPENDENCY (operator, D-041): his fills appear ONLY on result-card IMAGES which Orange never reads (OQ-10) - every fill recorded so far came from operator screenshots; the watch item SILENTLY UNDER-RECORDS if any campaign's cards go uncaptured. Mitigations: standing capture task result_card_capture_state.json + (0!) terminal-without-capture alarm in brain_refresh; OQ-10 re-ranked with OCR proposal due when queue clears.

open_risks_and_limitations.name: WIRE_NOMINAL_OPEN_OUTCOME_TERMINALS
open_risks_and_limitations.note: F002/F004 sit nominally OPEN in load_campaign_state (terminals were tracker/outcome-based, not instruction-token-based); only the 18h proximity window prevents mis-correlation - a MITIGATION not a fix, same latent class as the F003->F004 jam; fails if two genuine campaigns land close together or management arrives outside the window. DECISION MADE 2026-07-21 (D-036): option (3) ACCEPTED by operator with both conditions met - (a) fail-closed under ambiguity VERIFIED FROM CODE (P02: pause every candidate + FAIL_CLOSED_REVIEW, never mis-assigns), (b) terminal-marker canonical shape registered as future item (work_orders/FUTURE_ITEM_TERMINAL_MARKER_CANONICAL_SHAPE.md) with trigger 'before any increase in demo-lane autonomy beyond per-campaign human approval'. Residual risk stands accepted: two genuine campaigns inside 18h -> loud pause noise, no mis-assignment. REASSESSED 2026-07-21 (operator correction, D-042): the D-035 rationale that 'v2.1-era campaigns terminate via instruction tokens or adjudications, so the class stops growing' is WRONG - F007 terminated via OUTCOME-based P10 BE scratch with no token (third member: F002, F004, F007), and BE scratches/outcome terminals are the COMMON case, so the class grows with most campaigns. Revised residual risk: NOT static-rare but structural-frequent - F006->F007 arrived 17.6h apart (INSIDE the 18h window); had F006 not been adjudicated closed, every F007 management message would have triggered P02 pause + FAIL_CLOSED_REVIEW. With a growing nominal-open set, consecutive-day campaigns make pause-noise the EXPECTED behavior, not the edge case: still never mis-assigns (safety holds), but every such campaign demands manual review of every management action = alarm fatigue + Lane A capture degradation, the exact monitor-trust failure mode the operator has flagged. RECOMMENDATION (D-042): PULL the terminal-marker canonical shape FORWARD from 'before autonomy increase' to 'BEFORE THE DEMO LANE' - added to the demo-lane spec prerequisite list pending operator ratification.
